articles.summary: Benzinga: Investor Kevin O'Leary Says Movie Theaters Are Not Dead — 'The Only Restraining Aspect of Content Consumption is How Many Hours People Are Awake'. Critics of the possible $82.7 billion agreement for Netflix Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) to acquire the film and television assets of Warner Bros. Discovery (NASDAQ:WBD) fear the deal will be the death of movie theaters, but "Shark Tank" investor Kevin O'Leary says, "Factually, that's not correct." In a post on X, O'Leary argued that the competition isn't between streaming and theaters but a fight for human attention.
